name: google-veo
description: Google Veo 3.1 on Vertex AI: text, image (first/last frame) and extend to video as long-running operations, with inline video saving

nodes.title: Generate video
nodes.description: Generate a Veo 3.1 video from text, a first/last frame or a video to extend (paid per second; waits for the operation and saves inline videos)

prompt.description: What the video shows; dialogue in quotes, sounds described in words

negative_prompt.description: What the video must not show

person_generation.description: allow_adult (default) or disallow (no people or faces)

enhance_prompt.description: Let Veo rewrite the prompt (default true)

resize_mode.description: How an input image is fitted (default pad)

storage_uri.description: gs://bucket/folder for the output (required for 4k or sample_count > 1); without it one video comes back inline (base64) and is saved to GOOGLE_VEO_OUTPUT_DIR

image_gcs_uri.description: First frame in Cloud Storage, gs://... (image to video)

image_base64.description: Or the first frame as base64 bytes

image_mime_type.description: MIME type of the first and last frame images

last_frame_gcs_uri.description: Last frame in Cloud Storage, gs://...

video_gcs_uri.description: A Veo video (gs://..., mp4) to extend

wait.description: Wait for the video (default true); false returns the operation name at once for get_operation

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get operation
nodes.description: State of a Veo operation (done, error, videos as gs:// URIs or inline bytes); saves inline videos of a finished one into GOOGLE_VEO_OUTPUT_DIR

model.description: Model that started the operation, e.g. veo-3.1-generate-001

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Vertex AI Veo API request
nodes.description: Call any Vertex AI Veo API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/publishers/google/models/veo-3.1-generate-001". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/publishers/google/models/veo-3.1-generate-001"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
